item.title: New ECCO data show subcutaneous (SC) infliximab (Remsima™ SC) effectively recaptures and maintains disease control after drug holiday
item.description: A new post-hoc analysis from the LIBERTY studies, presented at ECCO 2026, demonstrated that initiating subcutaneous (SC) infliximab (Remsima™ SC) after a treatment interruption following intravenous (IV) infliximab induction helps patients with Crohn’s disease (CD) and ulcerative colitis (UC) recapture and maintain disease control1 The results demonstrated that SC infliximab provides an effective and safe option to regain clinical control after a planned or unplanned treatment interruption More
